required.q: Do I have to donate to use POPCORN?
required.a: No. POPCORN is free and every feature stays free. Donations are optional and simply help us keep it running.

safe.a: Transfers go straight to the developer's bank account through your own banking app. We never ask for card details on this site.

amount.a: Whatever you like. The amounts above are only ideas; any amount is appreciated.
